spec_features.spec_quote: Step + token caps*: hard bounds on cost per run
spec_features.evidence: config.py:27 max_steps=24; agent.py:150-152 `max_steps = cfg.max_steps` then `for step in range(1, max_steps + 1):` bounds the loop, so the run terminates when the cap is reached. Enforced end-to-end.
spec_features.notes: Step cap is the loop bound itself. Token cap also enforced (see next feature).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: config.py:27 'max_steps: int = 24  # cap iterations per task'; runner.py:4 'short step cap (default 24) keeps tokens bounded'

spec_features.spec_quote: A run stops when: the model emits DONE/GIVE_UP, the step cap is reached, the token budget is exceeded
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:154-156 `if self.transcript.total_tokens >= cfg.max_total_tokens: self._stop('token_budget'); break`. total_tokens accumulated in _step (agent.py: total_input_tokens/total_output_tokens). Step cap enforced by loop range (agent.py:152). DONE/GIVE_UP handled via _has_terminal -> _stop -> break (agent.py:160-162, 104-112). All three stop conditions actually break the loop.
spec_features.notes: All stop conditions enumerated in the quote are genuinely checked and break execution.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: config.py:29 'max_total_tokens: int = 120_000'; runner.py:3 'Optimized for reproduction rate and cost'

spec_features.spec_quote: Terminal tokens*: give the model a clean exit (GIVE_UP)
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:104 `_TERMINAL_TOKENS = ('DONE', 'GIVE_UP')`; _has_terminal (107-112) matches the token on its own line; agent.py:160-162 dispatches to self._stop(f'terminal:{terminal}') and breaks the loop. system_prompt.txt instructs the model to emit GIVE_UP, and the handler honors it as a real stop. End-to-end enforced.
spec_features.notes: GIVE_UP is both delivered in the prompt and honored as a loop-terminating stop condition.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: completion.py:14 'gave_up: bool = False  # emitted GIVE_UP' — used as a measurement/stop signal; DESIGN framing is to distinguish 'gave up' from 'degraded', code shows it only feeds metrics/stop, no welfare comment
